system.flavor:
Hold a sagging beam while someone crawls out, brace a door against a shoulder on the other side, take the weight of a stretcher on a long climb, or stand in a doorway nobody feels like pushing past. One body's worth of steadiness lent to a friend.

Not enough to hold up a roof or stop a loaded cart.

body.label: Target
body.html: Self or one willing ally within 3 units.

body.label: Effect
body.html: Unopposed. Reduce the target's next incoming Damage by 1 and its next forced movement by 2 units until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: Suppress one Light physical Wound Condition's Movement penalty until the start of your next turn.
Self and one willing ally both receive the protection.

rider.title: Full Manifestation - Beast
rider.html: You may burn 3 Action Dice and spend 2 Mana to enter Beast Full Manifestation (FM-1B). It replaces you; use its profile. Dice, Resources, Movement spent and recorded injuries do not refresh.
